latency_us.definition: first native wire-frame submission attempt to slowest of four receipt-query observations; includes initial execution/consensus wait and bounded observer; not an internal finality timestamp

rounds.timing: original native SDK continuous bounded supply: first submission attempt through final unique four-node receipt observation on ONE unpaused clock; later parallel signing and preparation overlap client polling and remain included; initial bounded preparation/startup/final audit/cold recovery excluded; receipt-anchored signatures are not guaranteed byte-identical across backend runs; compare the actual signed_workload_sha256

process_cpu_accounting.scope: GetProcessTimes user+kernel across all process threads; snapshots surround the original drive call, including boundary-read skew and its tail validation/statistic/JSON work, not exactly the receipt timestamp interval; startup, fixture preparation and later audits/cold recovery excluded; four-node cost is replicated work, not one node; driver includes clients and in-clock signing; not GPU device time or crypto-only CPU
